ctx.x: That's funny. I think he was using Joe Marcella.

Joe Marcella, yeah. Joe had the band at the Hickory House then. I think it was for business reasons, you know, trying to get himself up a little bit. And we even roomed together. Sharky and I lived together. But he used somebody else on clarinet, Joe Marcella, most of the time I think. And we played at Knicks and then we played at the Yacht Club on 52nd Street, at the Village Barn, quite a few places around there. And then my father died and so I decided to come home, try to make the funeral now. I missed it…
